book.name: METIU
book.title: Yeisu Wasane Dodohobine Metiu wana Luluweli

content: Yeisu I Pamolu Tomwalomwalo Hotiya
Yeisu i sai he wage ge i hadopanek i sehavile he habane.

Bwen bobode topadine si hiyewo luwom tomwalomwalo hotiya heine, i hiyene he wana bagahiyene. Sauge Yeisu i paidi wedi goru, i liwo tomwalomwalo yake heine i nga, “Natu, hatiyem i matuwo! Lam gegi Helak he matane hobak a nuwoyok.”
Iyete Logugui hana topapalapu topadine si pelihulihu-yanid si nga, “Tolomo ya i gobwage, i gopalongani Helak.”
Yeisu i lapu wadi nuwotu, bwen i liwo i nga, “Sahe kaiwane nuwotu ngakngakine hu nuwotuyan he hatiyemiu?
I meyan te hebe a nga, ‘Lam gegi Helak he matane hobak a nuwoyok.’ Agegene i puyowo te hebe a nga, ‘U suwoyuk ge u dodogan.’

Gane pupuyowane a lihuyan ge a ginawi, iloke hu lapu Tolomo Natune wana gaisi i gan he panayawi gegi i nuwoyok.” Habe i liwo tomwalomwalo heine i nga, “U suwoyuk, lam bagahiyene u howo ge u sehavile he lam guwole.”
Habeto tolomo yake i suwoyuk ge i sehavile he wana guwole.
Sauge boda si paidi, nuwadiye si hape ge si tobalan Helak, kaiwane gaisi sohode ti yake i giyau bobode heidiye.
Yeisu I Gon Metiu heine

Yeisu i seyok yawan yake ge i dodogan hedi, habe takis hana tohowo hotiya, hidane Metiu, i paidi i tutuwodau he wana bagakaiwo. I liwo heine i nga, “U dumuyai heyau.” Habeto Metiu i midi ge i dumuyai heine.
Yeisu mwage i hanhan Metiu he wana guwole, bwen takis hana tohowo ge togegi-yan si hoyowate si luwom he-bwaidiye Yeisu ge wana topadavae si hanhan toyao.
Farisi papaine si hite paidi, bwen si tayakid wana topadavae-yan si nga, “Sahe kaiwane lemi topapalapu he-bwaine takis hana tohowo ge togegi si hanhan toyao?”
Yeisu i longe lihu ya habe i nga, “Hebwaden si molu taine nuwadiye tohesawali, tobolebole ege nuwadiye.

Gen hu lok hu la lihu ya hana sapu hu luweni, i nga, ‘Nau taine nuwau man powopowoine, nuwau hatatilao pageine.’ Taine a deluwom tage hebwaden si nga ‘Hamai todohob’ a degon heidiye, age a luwom a gon togegi heidiye.”
Yeisu wana Papalapu ge Judiya wadi Mumuge Pageine Tan Bosowaine Si Detubwen Toyao

Habe Jon Tobaptais wana topadavae si luwom Yeisu heine ge si tayak si nga, “Sahe kaiwane hamai hene-bwaimai ge Farisi ha palahasik buwota hawanun kaiwane, age lam topadavae tan sauge hotiya si edeginawi sohode?”

Yeisu i golase halingadiye i nga, “Hebe haduwe hana sagae si ginawi, tab tohaduwe tolomoine wana pebwange-yan si tan, sauge hebe iye mwage bwaidiye? Taine! Agegene hana sauge habe i sevin, bwen hana siviye i ho yok tohaduwe tolomoine yake he gamwadiye, habeto si palahasik hedi buwota.
“Taine ta edehowo kaliko tovevai ge ta edepwas he kaliko toyaune masaseine, kaiwane hebe kaliko tovevai i momod pase, bwen i pakai masase yake.

Sohode hedi, taine waen tovevai ta edeligin he pwatum toyaune gane gout dimwene. Hebe ta ginawi sohode, gout dimwene bwele i masase, waen i daligi ge gout dimwene i ngak. Waen tovevai ta eligin he pwatum tovevai gane gout dimwene, iloke bwele ho-iwo si dohob toyao.”
Todedei Natune Vainiine ge Vaini I Midimidi-yan Madibe Lihuidiye

Yeisu he wana lihulihu yake gamwane, bwen Judiya wedi todedei hotiya i luwom i lipwakoko he hana hao ge i nga, “Natu vainiine sauge ya habe i mate. U luwom u la gen u bwange tuwane iloke yawedine i sehavile.”
Habeto Yeisu i suwomidi ge bwaine si lok, ge he-bwaine hedi wana topadavae-yan.
Vaini hotiya gide i ho i midimidi-yan madibe bwaime hana hohoyowate hwawate ho-iwo (12), i seluwom Yeisu he muine bwen i bwange hana kaliko busune.
Totone i nuwotu i nga, “Hebe hana kaliko ege a bwange, bwen a molu.”
Yeisu i galahaik i paidi, habe i nga, “Natu, hatiyem i matuwo! Lam goru hobak i pamoluiwo.” Ge petaege vaini yake i molu.
Sauge Yeisu i setuk todedei yake he wana guwole, i paidiid igo hana towi ge boda henebwaden si lok ge si yabwatan.
Bwen i liwo heidiye i nga, “Hu yogo. Vaini tei taine i demate, i hiyene ege.” Agegene wana lihu si niveyan.
Sauge bobode si leke tagi, bwen Yeisu i la i setuk vaini yake he wana rum, i bwange nimane habeto i suwoyuk.
Ge Yeisu wana ginawi yake wasane i reru he ganahao yake bwabwaligane.
Yeisu I Pamoluid Tomatagin Ho-iwo ge Tolomo Hotiya taine Halingane
Yeisu i seyok yawan yake ge i dodogan hedi, habeto tomatagin ho-iwo si sedumuyai ge si segongon si nga, “Deivid Tubune, u hatatilao-yanai.”
Sauge i la i setuk he guwole, habe tomatagin yake si luwom heine ge i tayakid i nga, “Tab hu goru heyau bosowau matamiu a palale?” Si golase halingane si nga, “Bam, Guyau.”
Habe matadiye i pihasik ge i nga, “Gen i youmate heimiu sohode he lemi goru.”
Ge matadiye i mwapwe. Yeisu i gokiki heidiye i nga, “Tab tolomo hotiya wana wase hu egiyau.”
Agegene sauge si yogo si pareru Yeisu wasane he ganahao yake.
Sauge bobode ya si sesetagi he guwole, tolomo hotiya yayaluwo bikbikine i solavi heine ge taine halingane i degan, si ho luwom Yeisu heine.

Sauge Yeisu i patile tagan yayaluwo bikbikine, habeto tolomo yake halingane i gan. Bobode hoyowate nuwadiye si hape ge si liwo si nga, “Tan sauge hotiya bigi sohode-yan ya ta edepaidi Isrel he gamwane.”
Age Farisi si nga, “Yayaluwo bikbikine wedi todedei he wana gaisi te yayaluwo bikbikine i epatile taganid.”
Tokaiwo Taine Si Dehoyowate

Yeisu i la i sebayavin he hiyebe lalahine ge yawan tankaikai heidiye. Ilok i papalapu he wedi guwole tapwalolo, i papawayae Helak wana bagalogugui wasane dodohobine, ge bobode henebwaden hedi gide ge hedi bole tomase ge tomase i pamoluid.
Sauge i paidiid boda, hatiyene i dau kaiwadiye, kaiwane tuwadiye i saole ge taine hedi tolabe, sohode sip henebwaden taine hedi tomatahasik.
Habeto i liwo wana topadavae heidiye i nga, “Baguye i kai hinone hobak i mweho, agegene tokaiwo taine si dehoyowate.
Iyete hu hawanun Guyau heine, iye baguye tonuwagane, iloke i patileid tokaiwo si la he wana baguye ge hinone si pase.”

footnotes.text: Lihu dedei i meyan ege, kaiwane tan bosowaine tolomo hotiya i depaidi hebe i youmate sohode wana lihu o taine. Agegene hebe i liwo tolomo heine i nga, “U suwoyuk ge u dodogan,” ge taine i deyoumate sohode wana lihu, bwele bobode si paidi. Iloke i puyowo te Yeisu i lihu sohode ti yake.
